notes: `problems: problems.isEmpty ? nil : problems` (line 923) means an empty array is never round-tripped as `[]` -- it is always written as JSON `null`, identical to the case where no problems were ever collected. A reader of the persisted file cannot distinguish "analyzer ran and found nothing" from "analyzer never ran" from this field alone. `LastStartupResult.problems` (HealthCardModels.swift:52) is `[StartupProblem]? = nil` specifically so older result files without the key still decode.
